facts.fact: 拖鳄尸进剥皮间、煮骨待放屋下
facts.anchor: we’d skin it, per usual, then boil the bones
Begging a fainting spell, I backed into the wall and sank to the concrete floor.

facts.fact: 次日涂药后在露台画素描
facts.anchor: I spent the morning sketching on the patio

facts.fact: 六点一刻穿薰衣草吊带裙下楼、藏染墨的手
facts.anchor: At six fifteen, I descended the stairs

facts.fact: 向宾客确认名字 Dart、Dartrine 的简称
Mama 曾骄傲解释全名含义、Michelle 事件后改叫 Dart
facts.anchor: Daria means upholder of good, and Catrine means pure.
This is a good time for your speech, ma’am.
A clear brown drink splashed onto my sandals.

facts.fact: Harrison 求私下谈、她拒绝直奔 Gazzie
facts.anchor: I snatched my hand off his arm and beelined toward Gazzie.

facts.fact: Gazzie 银勺敲杯开场致辞
facts.anchor: Raising her glass, Gazzie tapped it with a silver spoon.

facts.fact: 当众宣布继承、上午已签文件
当众宣布已改姓 Beaumont→Greer、下周出庭
facts.anchor: changing her last name from Beaumont to Greer
Instead of a hug, she shook my hand.

facts.fact: Aunt Virginia 低声要她需要离开就打电话
facts.anchor: Call me if you need to get out of here.

facts.fact: 上楼拧开 Leon 房门（这次无阻碍）、进屋锁门痛哭
facts.anchor: A sob wrenched forth, and I clapped my hand over my mouth
